observation_indicators.observable_fil: Ginamit ang kasalukuyang lokal na gabay at naipakita ang mahalagang hakbang: Piliin ang awtorisadong field, iwasan ang duplicate, at ipasa nang pribado ang WRA at buntis/postpartum list sa midwife.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Transfers approved fields accurately, avoids duplicate/missing entries and uses private handover.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Ilipat ang lahat ng detalye sa hindi awtorisadong spreadsheet.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Copy every detail into an unauthorized spreadsheet.

levels.kaya_na_en: Transfers approved fields accurately, avoids duplicate/missing entries and uses private handover.
